product_overview: SEEDUMOTOR is an integrated platform designed to manage and enhance motor skills development through AI-powered training, academic records management, evaluations, and interactive learning style assessments. It provides user authentication, comprehensive dashboards, and administrative tools to customize reports and AI model training configurations.
core_goals: Provide a secure and seamless authentication system for users.
Enable efficient management of children profiles and academic records.
Facilitate motor skills evaluations and learning style assessments through interactive questionnaires.
Offer AI-driven model training to improve evaluation accuracy.
Allow administrators to configure and customize PDF report generation.
Deliver user-friendly interfaces with guided tutorials to ease feature adoption.
key_features: User authentication with login and signup functionality.
Dashboard providing an overview and access to key modules.
Children management system for handling profiles and related data.
Academic record management to track learning progress.
Evaluation module for conducting and reviewing motor skill assessments.
Learning style assessment tools to personalize user experience.
Comprehensive questionnaires management: create, edit, take, and view results.
AI Training interface for configuring datasets and initiating AI model training with progress monitoring and metrics display.
Report generation and PDF report settings editor with templates, logos, color customization, and section management.
Parent links and resources to support users' family engagement.
Interactive step-by-step tutorials (Joyride) on key pages to enhance user onboarding.
user_flow_summary: User accesses the platform and logs in via /auth; upon successful authentication, redirected to /dashboard.
First-time users are guided through an interactive tutorial on the dashboard and other key pages (/children, /evaluations, /reports).
Users manage children profiles and academic records via respective pages.
Evaluations and learning style assessments are conducted through guided questionnaires.
Administrators access specialized routes for AI model training (/admin/training) and report customization (/admin/report-settings), with dedicated tutorials.
Users can generate, preview, and download customized reports in PDF format.
Parents access curated resources and questionnaires via parent links pages.
validation_criteria: Authentication flow must correctly handle login and redirect to dashboard.
Interactive tutorials must appear on first visits to /dashboard, /children, /evaluations, /reports, /admin/training, and /admin/report-settings.
AI Training module must allow dataset configuration, initiate training, show progress, update metrics (accuracy, F1-score), display confusion matrix, and enable metrics download as JSON.
Report settings editor must support report type and template selection, logo uploads, color customization, section order and toggle, save changes, and show preview.
Core functional pages must load securely and display data accurately.
LocalStorage must accurately track tutorial completion status; tutorial retrigger possible by clearing storage or using incognito mode.
End-to-end user flows including authentication, data management, evaluations, AI training, and report generation must be tested and verified for correctness.
